rows.name: Melee combat
rows.behavior: Real-time SM2 melee combos and held chainsword attacks using Titus animations.
rows.content_policy: Read companion weapons and animations into memory.

rows.name: Ranged combat
rows.behavior: Bolter fire, magazine ammunition and reloads using the equipped ranged weapon.
rows.content_policy: Read companion weapons, animations and sounds into memory.

rows.name: Equipment menu
rows.behavior: Select melee weapon through FFVII weapon slot and ranged weapon through its accessory slot; preserve materia and upgrades.

rows.name: Armor and contested health
rows.behavior: Armor plates absorb damage; melee hits regain contested health before decay.
rows.content_policy: Original rules code with companion-derived tuning identified from installed content.

rows.name: Parry and gun strike

rows.content_policy: Original combat integration with companion animations and sounds read in memory.

rows.name: Executions

rows.content_policy: Read companion execution animations and audio in memory.

rows.name: Grenades

rows.content_policy: Read companion visual and audio resources in memory.

rows.name: Fury

rows.content_policy: Read companion animations and audio in memory.

rows.name: Hybrid HUD
rows.behavior: Show armor, health and ammunition alongside FFVII command menu.
rows.content_policy: Original UI code; no copied icons or textures.

rows.name: Pour l’Empereur
rows.behavior: Play the actual SM2 For the Emperor gesture and voice together; cosmetic and cancellable.

rows.name: Party and chapter compatibility
